unitOfObservation: Label-transition, non-overlapping: one row per ticker per label-change; skip ticker until t + horizonDays after emitting. Weekly-sampled start dates.

changes: Initial production release. All scoring thresholds, sub-score weights, and decision boundaries as defined at this date.
PR 11: Accruals Ratio (Hribar-Collins 2002 cash-flow proxy of the Sloan 1996 anomaly) demoted from a scored Quality sub-metric to a diagnostic flag, per the post-2002 decay literature.

PR 11: CFO / Net Income scoring made asymmetric — values below the 0.5 floor penalise the Quality score; values above the floor do NOT boost it. The asymmetry preserves the well-supported 'low CFO/NI is an earnings-quality red flag' interpretation while removing the eroded alpha-source claim.
PR 11: extreme-decile accrual flags (bottom and top decile of the live universe) are now computed at scoring time and stamped on each row as accrualFlag and accrualFlagCutoffs.
Methodology document attribution corrected: Sloan 1996 → Hribar-Collins 2002 cash-flow proxy.
Pre-bump snapshots (scored under v1.0) remain immutable per the freeze-date discipline (PR 10.5).

PR 11.2: Quality near-miss tolerance switched from Math.floor to Math.round on the 20% failure-tolerance threshold. The floor variant produced a step-function discontinuity at every multiple of 5 in the evaluable rule count — surfaced by CB (Buy Now → Avoid in v1.1 despite the Quality SCORE going up by 0.1) when removing two passing rules dropped evaluable from 15 to 13 and the threshold from 3 to 2 while the failure count stayed at 3. Fix is sector-agnostic; preserves the documented '20% tolerance' semantic without introducing a second magic number.

PR 11.2: post-write fingerprint sanity check added to refresh_data_pi.sh and refresh_prices_pi.sh. Any stocks.json on disk that lacks rulesFingerprint after a refresh script exits is now caught immediately rather than silently breaking downstream email/alert scripts.

PR 9 bundle: Added SUE (Standardised Unexpected Earnings) sub-metric to the Timing component. Implements PEAD (Post-Earnings Announcement Drift) signal with time-decay weighting — full weight ≤ 30 days, 0.7× at 31-60 days, 0.4× at 61-90 days, skipped beyond 90 days. Dispersion path (analyst σ) takes priority; price-scaled fallback for stocks with sparse analyst coverage. Pre-registered anchors from Bernard & Thomas (1989) and Foster, Olsen & Shevlin (1984).

PR 9 bundle: Added FCF/profit-growth alignment sub-metric to the Quality component. Measures the delta of FCF 3y CAGR minus OperatingProfit 3y CAGR. Negative delta signals working-capital build-up, capital intensification, or accruals-based earnings. Skipped (not penalised) when data is sparse or base year is non-positive. Pre-registered anchors: bad=−0.10, ok=0.0, great=+0.05 (calibration against live universe recommended before first deploy). Academic grounding: Sloan (1996), Dechow (1994), Penman & Zhang (2002).
Freeze-date reset: OOS clock restarts 2026-05-06. In-sample weights NOT re-tuned. No retrospective re-scoring of pre-v1.3 snapshots.

Regime Fit: sector lists in src/data/regimes.ts restated in the canonical sector vocabulary (src/data/sectors.ts). The pre-v1.4 lists named styles and sub-industries (Aerospace & Defence, Infrastructure, Semiconductors, Small/Mid Caps, Small Caps, Defensives, Cyclicals, Profitless Growth, Hype AI) that never matched a stock.sector value, so the cautious tier in Early Recovery and Risk Off and most of the Stagflation preferred tier were inert. Mapping and rationale in preregistration_log.md Entry 0015. No effect under the Normal regime, which has been active since 2026-04-26; effect under other regimes is now what the documentation always claimed.
passFail.ts: marketCapUsdM() extracted and exported so the Discovery screen partitions the universe on the same USD-equivalent basis as the universe gate. Universe gate behaviour unchanged.

Analytics (not score-affecting, recorded here for provenance): model_analysis.ts drops universe-gate failures from every cohort instead of counting them as Avoid, and computes the per-snapshot rank IC on the full in-universe cross-section rather than on label-transition rows only.

Out-of-sample clock deliberately NOT reset: v1.4 is score-identical to v1.3 under the Normal regime that has been active since 2026-04-26 (0 label flips, 0 score moves on the 702-stock feed, verified before and after the change). The top-level frozenAt therefore stays at 2026-05-06; the v1.4 history entry records the date the version was cut. Weights, thresholds and gates not re-tuned. No retrospective re-scoring of pre-v1.4 snapshots.

Quality: the ROIC sub-metric now scores Greenblatt tangible-capital ROIC (EBIT / (NWC + net PP&E), pipeline field roicTangible) with anchors 0 / 15 / 60 (proposed 50 saturated 29.9% of the feed at the great clamp; 60 is the lowest round value under the pre-registered 25% saturation check, at 24.8%) where it is available; Financials fall back to the ROE-derived field with the unchanged 0 / 10 / 30 anchors; other stocks with no tangible value skip the rule instead of scoring the inflated ROE. Pre-v1.5 snapshots (field absent) score exactly as before. preregistration_log.md Entries 0016 / 0017.

Regime Fit: the +1 'strong fundamentals' boost (ROIC > 15% or operating margin > 15%) is removed. Both inputs are already scored in Quality; the boost was a hidden double count worth +2 overall points and, under Normal, the only thing Regime Fit varied on. Regime Fit is now the sector tier alone.

Gates: new data-sufficiency gate. A stock with fewer than half of the scored inputs present is labelled Avoid with that reason (passFail.data). Coverage floor, not a tuned parameter: on the 2026-08-25 feed it trips only tickers with no income statement.
Universe: 14 further LSE closed-end investment companies added to the exclusion list (same entity class and evidence pattern as PR 13). Not fingerprinted.

Analytics (not score-affecting): the point-in-time vintage store now accumulates across pipeline runs (first-seen quarter wins) and the re-scorer substitutes with four eligible quarters instead of five; the Track Record tab gains the two pre-registered interaction tests (QV bonus, late-cycle penalty) with verdicts withheld below N = 20 per arm.
Freeze-date reset: v1.5 moves live scores, so the OOS clock restarts 2026-09-02. Weights, the Buy Now threshold and the near-miss floors are untouched.

benchmarkNote: USD stocks → SPY; FTSE 100 stocks → ISF.L; FTSE 250 stocks → MIDD.L; other GBP stocks → VWRL.
